verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a lead can decide which external integrations the agent gets, because MCP servers are explicitly configured in ~/.gemini/settings.json (gh-19, gh-5). The /tools and /mcp commands let you inspect what is available (docs-3). There is no evidence of finer-grained restriction or policy enforcement, and 'Enterprise features: Advanced security and compliance' is too vague to credit. Missing for 10: per-tool allow/deny lists (including built-in tools like Google Search or shell), tool-call approval/confirmation controls, centrally enforced admin/org policies, and independent hands-on corroboration.
